description: This file contains internal utility functions related to session key management in an Android application. It provides methods to normalize session keys, determine if a key is canonical, resolve an agent ID from a session key, and build new session key strings based on device and agent IDs.

methods.name: normalizeMainKey
methods.description: Normalizes the raw session key by trimming whitespace or returns 'main' if input is null or empty.

methods.name: isCanonicalMainSessionKey
methods.description: Checks if the provided session key is the canonical 'global' or starts with 'agent:'.

methods.name: resolveAgentIdFromMainSessionKey
methods.description: Extracts the agent ID from the session key if it starts with 'agent:'.

methods.name: buildNodeMainSessionKey
methods.description: Constructs a session key string from device ID and optional agent ID.
